recognize_zh: 中央這顆嗜中性球的細胞質被一團均質、無結構、淡紫色的圓形吞噬物（hematoxylin body）占滿，原本的分葉核被擠到邊緣成新月形，這就是 LE 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Neutrophil containing a large, round, homogeneous, glassy pale-purple ingested body (hematoxylin body) occupying most of the cell
Native segmented nucleus compressed to a dark crescent at the cell periphery
Thin rim of cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules around the inclusion
Ingested material lacks chromatin texture or nuclear membrane detail
Background of marrow aspirate with red cells, a small cluster of pyknotic nuclear fragments and nearby immature cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a neutrophil whose cytoplasm is distended by a single large, round, homogeneous, structureless purple body that displaces the lobulated nucleus into a peripheral crescent. The ingested material shows no chromatin pattern, nucleolus or preserved nuclear membrane. Surrounding marrow elements and red cells are otherwise unremarkable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with an LE cell (neutrophil phagocytosis of opsonized, denatured nuclear material).

ddx.vs: A tart cell contains an ingested nucleus that retains chromatin structure and a nuclear outline, unlike the smooth homogeneous hematoxylin body of an LE cell.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil phagocytosing an intact apoptotic cell
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed apoptotic cells show condensed, dark pyknotic nuclear fragments rather than a single large, pale, glassy homogeneous mass.

ddx.dx: Cell with large cytoplasmic vacuole or artifact
ddx.vs: A vacuole or overlying debris is clear or refractile, whereas the LE body is a stained purple homogeneous mass that indents the nucleus.
